facts.fact: Lucan 的浴缸由大金属马槽改装，Micah 先沐浴。
facts.anchor: It’s a repurposed large metal horse trough

facts.fact: 洞中一夜三人相拥而眠。
facts.anchor: I fell asleep wrapped in his big, strong arms, Maple curled between us.

facts.fact: Micah 对 Lucan 有了更进一步的想法。
facts.anchor: But the thing is… I want more.

facts.fact: Micah 说明这是自己第一次与深爱的人亲密。
facts.anchor: I’m comfortable with you. I trust you.

facts.fact: Lucan 先问 Micah 想要什么。
每一步 Lucan 都先征得同意。
Lucan 透露过去恋人嫌他太大，近乎羞耻。
facts.anchor: Previous lovers have told me I’m far too big.

facts.fact: Micah 直言不介意他的身形。
facts.anchor: You’re perfect, Lucan.” I brush my thumb across his knuckles. “I’m not made of glass. You won’t hurt me.

facts.fact: 门外的 Maple 抓门求入。

facts.anchor: let myself sink into the warmth of the two creatures I’ve come to cherish most
